''R6'' - TheBuliderMC |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |music = Yes |moveable = Yes |interactable = No |newmusic = [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Smug|center|250px|thumb]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Peace and tranquility is all I need.|Store Description}} {{QuoteBox|Peace and tranquility.|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ == Description == '''Smug''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/109517370/profile MRePotatoes]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote. == Trivia == *This [[Emotes|emote]] is a reference to a [https://youtu.be/SHvhps47Lmc dance] from ''A Hat In Time''. **This is actually a parody from a [https://youtu.be/yD2FSwTy2lw video] based on the words of an error message in ''Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp''. **The [[Emotes|emote]] name is a reference to [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/smug-dancin this] meme. *The vocals in the song are from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JEs3sjdzHCc Equinox - Torn Asunder] and [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4t5JEStPXmo Equinox - Shotgun]. *On the 22nd of March 2022, the {{Color|Deluxe|Neon Rave}} [[DJ Booth]] used the music of this [[Emotes|emote]]. **However, the music when you used this emote did not play. **This was fixed later the same day. ==Music Lyrics== ''And I can't think clearly when you're here in my head'' ''When you're going under or you're torn asunder, not again...'' ''(Oh!)'' ''And I can't think clearly when you're here in my head'' ''When you're torn asunder or you're going under, not again...'' ''All I feel, cannot describe, what's going on, in my life'' ''The shame I feel, is far too real, it's getting harder to conceal'' ''When I'm alone, I close my eyes, imagine you right by my side'' ''My vision fades, it's getting dark, under my skin you left your mark.'' == Update History == *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **'''Smug''' added. *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **Music added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. {{EmoteNavBox}}
